learnings.title: Ledgerly SSO login uses SAML only
learnings.body: Finance portal access for Ledgerly switched to SAML. The password form still returns 200 but those sessions cannot export. Point users at the IdP tile Ledgerly-Prod.

learnings.title: Ledgerly report exports are comma CSV with ISO dates
learnings.body: Outbound Ledgerly reports for analysts use comma CSV and YYYY-MM-DD. Do not confuse with inbound import templates.

learnings.title: Ledgerly night jobs run in the EU-west vault
learnings.body: Batch jobs that talk to Ledgerly must run in the EU-west runner pool. US runners get blocked by the finance firewall.

learnings.title: Ledgerly API tokens expire after 90 days
learnings.body: Rotate Ledgerly service tokens every 90 days. Vault path finance/ledgerly/api. Expired tokens return 401 token_expired.

learnings.title: Ledgerly sandbox never posts to the GL
learnings.body: Ledgerly sandbox accepts imports with 202 but never posts to the general ledger. Use the sandbox event log to inspect.

learnings.title: Shipfast tracking webhooks use HMAC of the raw body
learnings.body: Inbound Shipfast tracking webhooks sign the raw body with HMAC-SHA256; verify against Shipfast-Timestamp in seconds.

learnings.title: Shipfast rate limit is 120 requests per minute
learnings.body: Shipfast returns 429 with Retry-After in seconds above 120 req/min per API key. Back off; do not rotate keys on 429.

learnings.title: Shipfast sandbox labels every label as TEST
learnings.body: Sandbox labels always print TEST in the corner. Never ship them to warehouses.

learnings.title: Shipfast account ids are numeric only
learnings.body: Shipfast account ids are digits. Passing a UUID returns 400 invalid_account.

learnings.title: Shipfast pickup windows are local warehouse time
learnings.body: Pickup SLA windows are in the warehouse local timezone, not UTC.

learnings.title: geo-api batch accepts at most 50 addresses
learnings.body: The /v1/batch endpoint rejects larger batches with 400 batch too large. Split client-side.

learnings.title: geo-api auth uses the X-Geo-Key header
learnings.body: geo-api rejects Authorization Bearer tokens with 401. Pass the team key in X-Geo-Key.

learnings.title: geo-api forward geocode is the only paid path
learnings.body: Reverse geocode is free for internal apps. Forward geocode counts against the monthly quota.

learnings.title: geo-api staging host is geo.staging.internal
learnings.body: Point CI at geo.staging.internal. Production is geo.prod.internal.

learnings.title: geo-api responses include a confidence field
learnings.body: Scores below 0.6 should be shown to a human before routing trucks.

learnings.title: Kestrel holiday calendar lives on Confluence
learnings.body: Treasury maintains Kestrel closures on the Confluence page Kestrel holidays. The bank API has no closures endpoint.

learnings.title: Kestrel sandbox host differs from production
learnings.body: Sandbox is api.sandbox.kestrel-pay.test; production is api.kestrel-pay.com. Never point CI at prod.

learnings.title: Kestrel payouts need a unique client_ref
learnings.body: Reuse of client_ref returns 409. Generate a new ref per payout attempt.

learnings.title: Kestrel supports SEPA and Faster Payments only
learnings.body: Wire schemes outside SEPA/FPS are refused with 400 unsupported_rail.

learnings.title: Kestrel webhook secrets rotate yearly
learnings.body: Vault path treasury/kestrel/webhook. Update receivers before 1 January.

learnings.title: Orion CRM title-cases display names on save
learnings.body: john smith becomes John Smith. Match on the stable customer number, not the display name.

learnings.title: Orion CRM list APIs use cursor pagination
learnings.body: next_cursor is returned; offset/limit pairs are ignored and re-read page 1.

learnings.title: Orion CRM sandbox resets nightly
learnings.body: Sandbox data is wiped at 03:00 UTC. Do not rely on fixtures across days.

learnings.title: Orion CRM custom fields use cf_ prefixes
learnings.body: Custom field keys must start with cf_. Other keys are dropped silently.

learnings.title: Orion CRM rate limit is 60 reads per minute
learnings.body: Burst above 60 returns 429. Writes share a separate 20/min bucket.

learnings.title: Postbird transactional templates need List-Unsubscribe
learnings.body: Publishing a transactional template without List-Unsubscribe is refused. Marketing templates are exempt.

learnings.title: Postbird sandbox suppresses delivery
learnings.body: Sandbox accepts with 202 and never delivers. Inspect the event log UI.

learnings.title: Postbird domains must pass DKIM before send
learnings.body: Unverified domains return 403 domain_unverified. Complete DNS first.

learnings.title: Postbird attachment size cap is 10 MB
learnings.body: Larger attachments return 413. Link to object storage instead.

learnings.title: Postbird click tracking is off by default
learnings.body: Enable click tracking per stream in the admin UI; it is not inherited.

learnings.title: Gatekeeper service accounts rotate every 90 days
learnings.body: Expired keys return 401 key revoked. Vault path gatekeeper/svc/<name>.

learnings.title: Gatekeeper admin UI is behind Okta
learnings.body: Humans use Okta SAML for the admin console. Machine clients use Gatekeeper tokens.

learnings.title: Gatekeeper staging issuer is https://gk.staging.internal
learnings.body: Do not mix staging tokens with the production audience.

learnings.title: Gatekeeper audit logs retain 180 days
learnings.body: Export before then if compliance needs longer retention.

learnings.title: Gatekeeper mTLS is required for admin APIs
learnings.body: Calls without a client cert return 401 mtls_required.

learnings.title: Paylane dashboard refunds take decimal major units
learnings.body: Dashboard refunds use amounts like 10.50. The API path is different.

learnings.title: Paylane webhooks retry for 24 hours
learnings.body: Failed merchant webhooks use exponential backoff for a day, then drop. Idempotency keys are required.

learnings.title: Paylane test cards are listed in the merchant FAQ
learnings.body: Use 4000 0000 0000 0002 for a generic decline in sandbox.

learnings.title: Paylane settlement reports land at 06:00 UTC
learnings.body: Files appear in the SFTP drop under /settlements/YYYY-MM-DD/.

learnings.title: Paylane supports EUR and GBP only on v3
learnings.body: Other currencies return 400 unsupported_currency on v3 endpoints.

note: Share vendor/subsystem tokens with TK targets but state different facts. No contrast labels. Used by --hard-distractors.
